We can lend you gold at the grand rate of... let me see... 0%. I guess we have to be attractive, considering the current state of affairs.

You can even contract multiple loans! Note that by borrowing money from our Bank, you tacitly agree to a contract that leaves us ample avenues of retribution in the event of a payment default on your end.
Hum? Oh it just means that we encourage you to pay back what you owe before leaving the Bank, that's all.
And then I said, "but I don't know where your golden costume is, my good sir. It was probably stolen. Are you sure that you looked everywhere in your vault?".
... Oh! A customer ! It's been so long since the last... nevermind. Welcome to our great Bank!
You can entrust your precious belongings to us, we'll take good... Hey wait a minute! That outfit! Where did you get it?!
You bought it? In prison?! Yeah, forget what I just told you, anybody can just waltz in and out of this Bank!
Maybe you can help us on that front, though. If you kill the monsters that are currently robbing our vaults, I'll have an easier time letting you leave with that stolen costume on your back.
Take that spare key. Fight well!
So boooooooooored... I really should have become an artist and...
Oh! A customer! It's been so long since the last... nevermind. Welcome to our great Bank!
You can entrust your precious belongings to us, we'll take good care of them!
... I would not advise doing so right now, though: there seems to be a minor security breach in the vaults.
Be assured that it's nothing to be concerned about! But if you want to take a look around and perhaps help out with the ah, security breach... Be my guest.
Here, take this spare key. Enjoy your time in our Bank!
The Bank teller seems to be away. There is a small sign on the desk:
"Dear customer, I'm on paid leave. Please help us maintain order in our splendid facility using the key on the back of this sign.
Thanks a lot, feel free to borrow money, we are a safe and respectable Bank."
What a trusting little fellow. I'm not sure that's really safe in this line of business but hey...

key: On se fait quand même BIEN chier, maintenant...
en: It was WAY more fun crawling round the sewers.
Hey, I've finally found the muscular guy in blue!
Hey, have you seen a muscular guy in blue?
Belmont, blood of the enemy. Are you his ally, interloper?
It doesn't matter. You entered my Castle uninvited. You'll pay dearly for this affront.
It's you who appeared out of nowhere with all your horrible monsters!
Perhaps the same could be said of all bosses...
I am not much of a human anymore, but this Richter was a man worth saving!
I am not much of a human anymore, but this Richter is still a man worth saving!
What is a man? A miserable little pile of secrets!
But enough talk... Have at you!
Die monster. You don't belong in this world!
It was not by my hand that I am once again given flesh.
I was called here by humans who wish to pay me tribute.
You steal men's souls and make them your slaves!
Perhaps the same could be said of all religions...
Your words are as empty as your soul! Mankind ill needs a savior such as you!
What is a man? A miserable little pile of secrets !
But enough talk, have at you!
We meet again at last, Belmont. Let's finish this.
Dracula! I'll make you pay for what you did to her!
You can't just copy my wardrobe to get my immeasurable powers.
I'll make you pay for this unspeakable offense, you wretch!
So it has come to this. My most trusted lieutenant turns on me...
You were nameless before I made you what you are.
What I created, I can also destroy!
...Even my own ornamental armors are threatening me, now. Where is the world heading?!
Wait, it's you?! How dare you address me like this?!
ENOUGH! No one has ever dared speak to me on that tone before!
Ah, the traitor, Hector... Why did you betray me?
Why did you unleash your hatred upon the humans?
When you began slaughtering them indiscriminately, I had no choice but to disobey you.
You side against me... for the sake of humans? Humans are not worth the air they breathe! I was simply cleansing the world.
It is not your place to judge the worth of humans.
The powerful always judge the weak. The humans made their judgement of me, as well.
Thus I sentenced them... to extinction. Sympathy is merely a form of weakness.
You betrayed me, Hector... And for that, the punishment is death.
Well met, my son! It's been a long time.
I was hoping we would not see each other again.
I can't allow you to leave here, Father.
You have ever been the ally of humans. Have you forgotten what they did to your Mother?

Think you I would forget such a thing?
No. But neither do I seek revenge against them.
Still uttering the same nonsense. No matter.
Now is the time to put aside your weak human side and join me in remaking this world!
Dracula, in the name of my mother. I will defeat you again.
I will end you and your Curse, in the name of my family!
A Belnades. Merely an assistant to the Belmonts. Destroying you will be a formality.
You won't capture me as easily this time!
I don't even know who you are...

en: For the last time, my scissors are NOT made to cut hairs! Especially not those of some rotting zombie!
Blah blah blah... you never let me do anything anyway and... oh! A newcomer!
Nice to meet you, I'm the Tailor's daughter! I myself am studying to become a hairdresser... I WAS studying before all my teachers died, at least...

At least, I beg you to help her work on her studies ... ask her, she might be able to comb your... green thingy.
Oh yeah! I can help you find your new style!
But I forbid you from plunging my sewing scissors in that thing!

key: Explorez un Arboretum luxuriant, pataugez au cœur d'un Marais suffoquant et affrontez un nouveau boss. Ce contenu conçu pour étendre l'univers de Dead Cells est accessible dès le début du jeu et rendra vos runs encore plus variées.
en: Explore a relaxing Arboretum, wade through a noxious Morass and take on a new boss. This is early game content designed to expand the Dead Cells universe and add variety to runs for people looking to support the development of the game.

Take a break on the coast! Soak up some sun as you explore the Fractured Shrines. Enjoy the view from the Undying Shores and meet the locals. We hope you'll enjoy this challenging early game content we built to add some variety to the middle of your runs.

Battle your way through sunken shipwrecks, scale a burning lighthouse and confront your deadliest foe yet. If you manage to make it through all that, maybe you’ll finally get off this god-forsaken island... 
This late-game content gives you an alternative to the High Peak Castle, Derelict Distillery and Throne Room biomes.

Team up with Richter Belmont & Alucard and fight through the ancient corridors of Dracula's Castle, wielding iconic Castlevania weapons against hordes of famous monsters to reach the throne room of the Dark Lord himself.
Two new levels, three bosses, a soundtrack of 60 classic Castlevania tunes, a new storyline and Richter Mode!

en:
Dead Cells is back... with the 35th free update The End is Near! 

Discover new twists on one of our most iconic mechanics, Curse, and unlock 3 new weapons, 3 new mobs and 3 new mutations. A new biome effect, Cursed Biome, gives you the choice to enter a biome infested with the 3 new curse-related mobs in exchange for extra rewards. 

A bunch of new legendary affixes, reworks and rebalances, plus new & updated accessibility features are now available. 

Plus, don’t forget to visit the Tailor’s Daughter for more outfit options with 42 brand new heads!  

More information in Patch Notes.
What?! I can't believe my eyes!
You are the Beheaded! The one that's never really dead!
I'm your biggest fan!.. The only one too...
Hum, I mean that it's an immeasurable honor to meet you! Keep up the good work, you're awesome! I know you'll go far in these trials!
Oh, this? Yes, I do a little bit of sculpting in my spare time, so I figured that I'd do a little something in your honor! I'll make it even more beautiful as you conquer greater challenges!
Ah! A new challenger! Welcome to my proving grounds!
Here, you can fight your most formidable past enemies one after the other.
Should you triumph, you'll receive wonderful rewards and the people (or what remains of them) will sing your praises for years to come.

And if you find it too easy, your opponents have prepared new fighting techniques to surprise you!
Try completing the challenge without getting hit!

I prepared a few items taken from my arsenal for you. Go ahead and gear up!

Whenever you're ready, just go through the door at the end of the corridor. Serious business begins there!
If you get cold feet, you can always come talk to me to abandon the challenge.

key: Cette porte ne s'ouvrira pas si j'ai encore des cellules sur moi.
en: This door will not unlock until you have spent ALL your cells.

key: Cette porte ne s'ouvrira pas tant que je n'aurai pas choisi des Mutations.
en: This door won't open until you've chosen your Mutations.
Yeah, this won't budge. Damned magic Castle...

key: We'll set sail as soon as you're ready.
en: We'll set sail as soon as you're ready.

key: Be advised that what's lurking in the Shipwreck is really... unsavory, even by my standards.
en: Be advised that what's lurking in the Shipwreck is really... unsavory, even by my standards.

key: But I'm sure you didn't come that far to get cold feet, did you?
en: But I'm sure you didn't come that far to get cold feet, did you?
Once more, I have to stop my father. When will it truly end?
Take the elevator and get inside the Castle, quickly!
Go ahead, I need to prepare first. Where is my shield ? I am sure to have been buried with it...
Traitor in the eyes of the creatures of the night, monster in those of the humans... it's hard being a dhampir!
Ohhh I really need to stretch... centuries without moving sure stiffens the muscles!
I need time to devise a new plan.
Death is my father's right hand and a vicious foe. I wouldn't be surprised to see him come back eventually...
Strangely, he didn't remove all your powers and equipments...
You triumphed in this fight to the Death, congratulations.
It will only get worse from now on. Prepare yourself for a long-fought battle.
You'll need to go through the Castle again, but this time, we'll go straight there.
Have you seen my sword? I can't find it anywhere...
One can't really kill Death itself. There won't be any respite for the mortals...
Don't be discouraged by your previous failure. You can do it!
Meet me in the Clock Room once more. You'll succeed this time!
The Castle may be full of danger, but you can't falter now.
I'm not against some backtracking in a castle, I'm used to it.
We're almost there. To think that I'll see my father again just to stop him once more...
Your Clock is really impressive! Something is off, though...
Still, what a wonderful coincidence that your island too has a Clock Tower. As luck would have it indeed!
Do you also need two rings to reach the secrets of your Clock Room? No? Lucky you...
I understand your fear, but you have to go stop my father!
I am sorry to leave this responsibility to you like this.
May your victory also solve my father issues.
This Castle is sturdy, don't hestitate to give it your all during the fight, it's safe.
You can only enter the Return to Castlevania DLC once per run.
If you enter the prison, I can't help you anymore!

key: I noticed that you were having a hard time surviving the island and I'm looking for a new guin... ahem... collaborator, to help me do some experiments! I call them Aspects.
en: I noticed that you've been having a hard time surviving on the island and I'm looking for a new guine... ahem... collaborator, to help me with some experiments! I call them Aspects.

key: They are incredible enhancements, designed to make their host way stronger.
en: They are incredible enhancements, designed to make their host much stronger.

key: Would you like to try one? Come on, it's free!
en: Would you like to try one? Come on, it's free!

key: I mean, I owe you that much, considering that I developed them using your corp... errrm, stuff that I found.
en: I mean, I owe you that much, considering that I developed them using your corp... errrm, I mean, some old stuff that I found laying around.

key: Oh and come back often! I tend to develop new Aspects with every new... source of material!
en: Oh and come back often! I tend to develop new Aspects with each new... delivery of material!

key: Howdy, science friend! How are we going to enhance you today?
en: Howdy, science friend! How are we going to enhance you today?

key: Over here! Come give your body to science!
en: Over here! Come give your body to science!

key: My other collaborators? Let's just say that they... HAD to quit.
en: My other collaborators? Let's just say that they... HAD to quit.
Go ahead and clean the vaults, will you?
Don't forget to pay back what you owe, okay?
I hope that these intruders will go away someday... This heist is bad for business.
Still there? Don't you have something to do, like saving our glorious Bank?
That door won't open if you don't have the key I just gave you.
Don't ask me how it works. I just know that it's a way to make sure you'll have it when it's needed.
No key, no vault. Take. The. Key. It's not that hard.
Come on, it's getting embarrassing now.
Hey there, customer! How loyal of you to come back!
Hello, dear customer! We still seem to be suffering from a heist situation!
Oh, it's you again! You know the way.

Congratulations!
Do you want to leave this run?
Do you want to abandon this Boss Rush run?
Glad to see such a determined face... or whatever it is that sits on your shoulders.
Go forth, prisonner, and prove your worth in battle!
Craving for thrills? You've come to the right place!
You're back to the crucible of combat!
Glad to see that you're not afraid to face some challenge.
What will you try this time?
How far will you go this time?
Well fought! But don't rest on your laurels, your next challenge awaits!

You killed it!
... Got it? Anyway, next!
Who will you face of against next? Fate will tell.
Impressive work for a skinny one like you!
You triumphed over impossible odds, you can be proud of yourself.
It's a victory for the prisonner! Who would have thought?!
What a dismal defeat. Do better.
You can't win them all... but at least try!
Better luck next time... but remember that luck isn't everything.
Win or win not, there is no try.

key: NYAH AH AH AH AH AH AH AH AH AH AH AH
en: NYAH HA HA HA HA HA HA HA HA HA HA HA!

key: Alors comme ça, tu as réussi à trouver cet endroit...
en: So you've stumbled through a rift, eh...

key: Et tu aimerais bien prendre ces trésors, hein ?
en: Bet you'd like to take these little beauties with you, now wouldn't you?

key: Et bien sache que si tu décides de les prendre, sortir d'ici sera beaucoup moins aisé que d'y entrer...
en: Well, if you do decide to take them... Getting out won't be anything like getting in...

key: Bonne chance... NYAH AH AH AH AH AH AH
en: Good luck... NYAH HA HA HA HA HA HA!
Our sole purpose is to destroy Dracula so people can look to dawn without fearing the darkness.
My specialty is glyphs rather than alchemy but I should be able to help nonetheless.
Are you the morning sun, come to vanquish this horrible night?
So this is the anomaly she's looking for...

key: Vous vous êtes aventuré bien loin sous la surface, Déchu.
en: You've come a long way down beneath the surface, Fallen One.

key: Obscure est la voie que vous avez choisi d'emprunter...
en: Dark is the path you have chosen...

key: La lumière des stèles gardiennes vous accompagnera.
en: The light of the guardian monoliths will guide you.

key: Mais pour combien de temps encore ?
Derrière vous, la grosse LUMIERE, juste là !
en: Behind you, that big LIGHT, just there!

key: Vous ne seriez pas le prisonnier décapité vous ?
en: You wouldn't happen to be that headless fellow, would you?
What's the matter? Cat got your tongue?

key: Oh. Oui, pardon. Vous AVEZ perdu votre langue.
en: Oh, yes. Forgive me. You've misplaced your tongue.

key: Cela doit être étrange de revenir d'entre les morts.
en: Anyway, it must be strange to be back from the dead...
I mean, surely you must have noticed?

key: Mais vous n'êtes pas le premier dans ce cas là, si c'est votre question...
en: But you're not the first to find yourself in this situation, if that’s what you want to know...
Shouldn't you be on your way?

key: I heard tales about a dubious yet capable being roaming around the island... I guess you’re the one?
en: I heard tales about a dubious yet capable being roaming around the island... I guess you’re the one?

key: Well no matter what or who you are, you’re stuck in here too, right?
en: Well no matter what or who you are, you’re stuck in here too, right?

key: We met on the docks and I...
en: We met on the docks and I...

key: Yeah, sorry about all that impaling, I was only doing my job.
en: Yeah, sorry about all that impaling, I was only doing my job.

key: Anyhow, you’re stuck in here too, right?
en: Anyhow, you’re stuck in here too, right?

key: I may have an idea to get us out, but I need your help.
en: I may have an idea to get us out, but I need your help.

key: While I was roaming around the island, looking for a ship decent enough to go across the sea, I discovered an old extinguished lighthouse at the extreme north of the Island.
en: While I was roaming around the island, looking for a ship decent enough to go across the sea, I discovered an old extinguished lighthouse at the extreme north of the Island.

key: It's probably not much, but at least, that’s our best chance.
en: It's probably not much, but at least, that’s our best chance.

key: I will be waiting for you near the Castle, to bring you as close as I can... Unfortunately, the abominations hanging around mean I can’t go very close.
en: I will be waiting for you near the Castle, to bring you as close as I can... Unfortunately, the abominations hanging around mean I can’t go very close.

key: Michel, one of the old keepers, used to live in the stilt village... Maybe you should pay a visit to his house?
en: Michel, one of the old keepers, used to live in the stilt village... Maybe you should pay a visit to his house?

key: Ca sera sûrement très joli quand toutes ces flasques seront illuminées.
en: This is certainly going to be something when all the flasks are lit up.
You're working on it, aren’t you?
Odd kind of place though, no matter how you look at it.

key: Vous ne seriez pas le prisonnier décapité, vous ?
en: Aren't you the headless fellow that's been getting around?

key: Oh. Oui, pardon. Vous N'AVEZ PLUS de langue.
en: Ah yes, that's right... No tongue.
Ah, you're not one of them! You scared me!
It ate him! Swallowed him whole!
So I killed them all. And not just the large ones, but the medium and small ones too.
Every bag I could find. But I know some survived. They are still here. They will eat us all...
Oh, you're not a big bag, just a headless zombie. You scared me.
They got away! They are everywhere now!
I spotted one in this place! I couldn't kill it but I managed to escape!
It probably changed back to its deceiving form, now. Beware!
Would you like to buy something?

key: Je n'ai pas grand chose, désolé.
en: I don't have much right now...

key: Un jour, moi aussi j'aurai une vraie boutique.
en: One day I'll have a real shop, all of my own!

key: Peut-être qu'ils arrêteront de m'appeler "Guilain le stagiaire".
en: Maybe then they'll stop calling me "Guillain the intern".

key: Achetez quelque chose sinon ils vont me punir !
en: Buy something, or else they'll punish me!

key: Ca n'a pas l'air de s'être très bien passé pour vous on dirait.
en: Seems like you've been having a rough time of it...

key: Vous avez remarqué que tout semble différent à chaque fois ?
en: Have you noticed how things seem to change each time you pass through?

key: On croirait presque que cette île est vivante.
en: One could get to thinking that the island is alive.
It's quite ridiculous, wouldn't you say?

key: Ca sera sûrement très joli, quand toutes ces flasques seront remplies avec l'aide du Collecteur.
en: I imagine this will be a sight to behold when you and the Collector have lit all the flasks up.

key: Ah ah, oui... Evidemment que vous y travaillez.
en: Obviously you're chipping away at it.
Oh! A visitor! I was starting to lose hope of Richter coming to free me!
... So that I could tell him that I don't need it! I can look out for myself!
I had sent my kitty cat Byakko on a mission to get me the key to this room but he came back empty-pawed!
I guess I have you to thank for that... Anyway, I'm free at least!
My cat seems to like you, don't forget to give him a little scratch behind the ears! As for me, I'll pack my things and go help Richter. What would he do without me...
If you go on an adventure with my cat, take good care of him! If something were to happen to him, I'd throw a dove in your face!
Of all my imprisonments, this one was probably the least tedious. I had a teapot and my cat, at least.
My cat's name? Depends on who you ask!
Have you met Richter? He's supposed to feed my cat this week...
You'd be a fool to underestimate me! My pockets are full of friends and I won't hesitate to use them!

key: Vous... vous z'avez pas le droit aux mutations auzourd'hui !
en: You... You c-c-can't have any mutations today!

key: Z... Ze suis bien content d'avoir découvert ce tas de cadavres !
en: I'm really happy I found this great stinking pile of corpses!

key: Vous n'imazinez pas tout ce qu'on trouve là dedans !
en: You can't even imagine all the stuff you can find in here!

key: Tiens, d... d... d'ailleurs, ce... c'est drôle, vous leur ressemblez beaucoup.
en: By the way, it's an odd thing to say... But you... kind of look like these guys...

key: Ah, et d... désolé pour l'odeur.
en: Oh yeah, sorry about the smell...

key: En tous cas, c'est b... bien plus amusant que de revendre de la ca... c... camelotte.
en: In any case, it beats selling a bunch of old ju... Stuff... Yeah, stuff.

key: Bon, ze vais regarder si ze peux vous tr... trouver d'autres immondices dans ces c... corps !
en: Well I'm going back to digging through the filth for some more goodies!

key: On se reparle p... plus tard !
en: I'll see you again, I guess...

key: Je sais que c'est bon, mais il ne faut pas en abuser...
en: I know it's good, but you mustn’t overdo it...

key: Vous avez la peau bien pâle, vous avez dû attraper la maladie...
en: You're looking a little... pale. You must have caught that disease...

key: Ne vous inquiétez pas, je sais comment soigner les gens.
en: Don't worry, I know how to look after people.

key: Je ne suis pas comme ce charlatan d'alchimiste !
en: I'm not like that alchemist charlatan!
He has no idea what he's doing...

key: Je suis un homme de science moi !
Bref approchez et détendez vous, ca risque de piquer un peu.
en: Right, come here and relax - this might sting a little.

key: Eh voila ! Ca va mieux hein ?
en: There we go! Feeling better now?

key: Quoi ? Une bonne petite saignée ca marche à tous les coups !
en: What? A little bloodletting always does the trick!
Oh, now don't be like that!

key: Tenez prenez un bonbon, c'est offert par la maison.
en: Here, have some candy, it's on the house.
I see you are a specialist. Your scarf is there to protect your neck from bitings, am I right?
If you see Maria, tell her that I won't be able to feed her cat this week.
I'm free, at last! Thanks again!
I'll have to fight him once again... It doesn't bode well.
Did you meet Alucard on your way to the Castle? He's a precious ally when it comes to fighting his father!
My last fight with Dracula was gruelling...
Hey, it's you! Thanks again for freeing me, my decomposed friend!
Sadly, I won't be able to join you either. Dracula drained all the strength out of my body during our previous fight... Kill him for me, okay?

key: Il parait qu'être maudit peut valoir le coup...
en: Seems being cursed isn’t all bad...

key: J'ai cru entendre dire que les monstres sont de plus en plus belliqueux à mesure qu'on s'approche de la fin...
en: I've heard the monsters get nastier and nastier as you get closer to the end...

key: Apparemment, des choses sont cachés dans les murs. Peut-être que ça vaut VRAIMENT le coup de les scruter.
en: Apparently there are things hidden in the walls... Might REALLY be worth taking a closer look.

key: Alors comme ça, on est venu chercher un peu de challenge ?
en: So you've come in search of a little challenge?

key: Ici, seuls les meilleurs des meilleurs...
en: Here, only the best of the best...

key: Que dis-je, L'ÉLITE DE L'ÉLITE... parvient à faire un score honorable !
en: Or should I say, the ELITE OF THE ELITE... can manage to rack up a respectable score!
Do you think you're up to it?

key: Dans ce cas, descends derrière moi, et occis le boss d'ici le plus vite possible tout en faisant un maximum de points.
en: In that case, head down and defeat this level's boss as fast as you can while scoring as many points as you can manage.

key: Pour t'aider, tu trouveras de l'équipement sur ton chemin, mais il se peut que certains objets soient interdit.
en: You'll find some equipment to help you along the way, but some objects may be forbidden.

key: Peut-être que le Collecteur y est pour quelque chose, qui sait...
en: The Collector might have something to do with that, who can say...

key: Et n'oublie pas, le chemin le plus court n'est pas forcément le meilleur...
en: And don't forget, the shortest path isn't always the best...
You weren't all that good now were you...

key: J'ai noté vos "exploits". Enfin si on peut appeler ça comme ça.
en: I've noted your... "achievements", if that's what you want to call them.

key: Vous mourez de plus en plus vite à ce que je vois.
en: You really aren't getting any better are you?
Bring it back to me quick!

key: Elle est quelque part dans le coin ! Je le sais, je le SENS !
en: It's somewhere around here! I know, I can FEEL it!

key: Oh ma chère petite rune, où te trouves-tu...
en: Oh, where are you, my precious little rune?

key: Qu'est ce que tu attends ?! Vas-y !
en: Well, what are you waiting for? Get moving!

key: Ça n'est pas en restant ici que tu vas récupérer la... ma rune...
en: You're not gonna get the... my rune back by hanging around here...

key: Tu ne voudrais pas abandonner une pauvre âme en peine, hein, dis moi ?
en: You wouldn't abandon a friend in need, now would you, huh?

key: Un peu lent, mais t'as l'air de comprendre ce que je dis...
en: A little slow... But you seem to understand what I'm saying...

key: J'ai perdu une r... Je veux dire MA rune. Du coup, je suis coincé ici.
en: I lost a ru.. I mean MY rune. So you see, I'm a little stuck...

key: Et j'ai BESOIN de ma rune...
en: And I NEED my rune, you see...

key: Tu ne voudrais pas aller me la chercher ?
en: You wouldn't mind finding it for me, would you?

key: Hé hé, merci. Elle est quelque part dans ces égouts, de ton côté de la grille.
en: Ho ho! Thank you! It's somewhere around here in these sewers, on your side of these bars...

key: C'est ici qu'elle se trouve ! La... MA rune se trouve un peu plus bas !
en: It's here! The... MY rune is just a little bit further on!

key: Quoi ? Mais non, tu n'as rien à craindre !
en: What? Not at all, nothing to worry about!

key: Après être arrivé jusqu'ici, tu n'en feras qu'une bouchée !
en: After coming this far, you’ll make short work of all that!

key: J'ai vu ton combat, c'était plutôt impressionant.
en: I saw your fight. It was pretty impressive.
Did you...? Did you get it?

key: Très bien. Maintenant, donne la moi.
en: Excellent! Now give it to me!

key: J'en étais sûr... Tu es comme les autres, après tout...
en: I knew it... You're just like all the rest...

key: Je récupèrerai ma rune, sois-en sûr...
en: I'll get my rune back, you'll see...
I'll get it back, you'll see...

key: Tu ne perds rien pour attendre...
en: You’ve nothing to lose by waiting...
Reach the City to... wait, what... is this place?
You look... different... where are your... cards?
Here... take this Prismatic Shard deck...
A little bit of this... a little bit of that...

key: Et bah c'est pas trop tôt !
Approchez, approchez je vais pas vous couper...
en: Come closer! I won't cut you, don't worry.

key: Je suis le Tailleur. Grâce à moi, vous pourrez changer de style, juste derrière, là.
en: I'm the tailor. I can fix you up with some proper clothes!

key: J'ai passé un... marché dirons nous, avec notre "ami" commun le Collecteur.
en: I struck a... deal with our mutual friend, the Collector.

key: Vous lui apportez des schémas de tenue, et je vous les confectionne !
en: You bring him the templates and I will craft it for you!
Ah, here comes my favorite customer! Know that your loyalty does not go unnoticed!
Here, take a pair of collector edition scissors as a thank you!
Oh, here you are! I actually wanted to say that...
Your sense of style is so inspiring! I'd love to be just like you when I turn... dead?
Here is a token of my admiration! Use it to comb-o through your enemies!

key: Si seulement Karl pouvait vous voir...
en: If only Karl could see you!
A great choice! It really brings out your eyes.
Hey, I've got new heads for you.
No, I don't reveal my name to any random walking corpse I meet, sorry.
Eww ! Look at you! Someone needs a good combing!
Hey, I've got a new technique to try out. Can I borrow your head for a bit?
Nothing to do... I'd almost regret my classes...
Oh no, I can't comb this!
I'm an aspiring head dresser, not a magician!

I should be able to style that head after I complete my studies. Considering the current state of the kingdom, expect a waiting time of about one or two eternities, and it's the most reasonable timeline.
Oh what, are you for real?! I'm just a beginner! No way I can do anything about that, sorry.
I deal in hairs, not miracles!

key: Il faut faire PLUS de sacrifices...
Bienvenue dans notre humble chapelle, fidèle ! Êtes-vous prêt à faire un sacrifice ?
en: Welcome to our humble chapel, brother! Are you ready to make a sacrifice?

key: Priez pour votre salut ... avec un sacrifice.
en: Pray for your salvation... with a sacrifice.

key: Les mots sont vaincs, seuls les sacrifices comptent ...
en: Words are meaningless, only sacrifices are important...

key: Elle vous voit, et elle sourit !
en: She sees you, and she smiles!

key: Qu'est-ce qu'il est lourd, ce chapeau.
Pick which monsters you want to fight and press the button. || TutoKnight Training room tuto
en: Pick which enemies you want to fight and press the button.

key: You can also select a zone and all the enemies from the room will turn into ones taken from that zone!
en: You can also select a zone and all the enemies in the room will turn into ones taken from that zone!

key: Remember: you can't die here. You'll just go back at the entrance.
en: Remember: you can't die here. You'll just go back to the entrance.

key: In case you forgot how my training room works...
en: In case you forgot how my training room works...

key: Just pick your gear, choose your mutations and go kill some monsters!
en: Just pick your gear, choose your mutations and go kill some enemies!

key: Behind the first door, you can fight any monster you have already encountered.
en: Behind the first door, you can fight any enemy you have already encountered.

key: There are also big doors at the back of the room, but I don't know where they lead...
en: There are also big doors at the back of the room, but I don't know where they lead...

key: Hello there! Welcome to the Combat Room!
en: Hello there! Welcome to the Combat Room!

key: I'm handling it for my knightly friend. You can call it undead solidarity.
en: I'm handling it for my knightly friend. You can call it undead solidarity.

key: Pick which monsters you want to fight and press the button.
en: Pick which enemies you want to fight and press the button.

key: You can even select enemies from a specific zone of the island and instantly fill the room with them!
en: You can even select enemies from a specific zone of the island and instantly fill the room with them!

key: Oh and don't worry: you can't die here. You'll just go back at the entrance.
en: Oh and don't worry: you can't die here. You'll just go back to the entrance.

key: Give it your all and train like crazy!
en: Give it your all and train like crazy!

key: Oh hi there. I'm not dead anymore!
en: Oh hi there. I'm not dead anymore!

key: Welcome to my very own training room!
en: Welcome to my very own training room!

key: It's great to see you invested in your training!
en: It's great to see you invested in your training!

key: Are you still eager to practice? You're in the right place!
en: Are you still eager to practice? You're in the right place!

key: It's all about training here... Kill or die trying!
en: It's all about training here... Kill or die trying!

key: So this is were these doors lead! Neat!
en: So this is where these doors lead! Neat!

key: I guess it works just like the other room, so go ahead and train all you want.
en: I guess it works just like the other room, so go ahead and train all you want.

key: Once more unto the breach, I see?
en: Once more unto the breach, I see?

key: And once again, don't fear death.
en: And once again, don't fear death.

key: Condition: ne subir aucun dégât dans le niveau précédent.
en: Condition: take no damage in the previous level.

key: Condition: tuer ::n:: ennemis sans subir de dégât.
en: Condition: kill ::n:: enemies without taking any damage.

key: Encore ! Ramène moi plus de cellules !
en: Go Back! Bring me more Cells!

key: Allez ! Juste quelques unes de plus !
Ne sois pas si radin ! Pense à ton pote !
en: Don't be such a cheapskate! Share with your old pal!

key: Avez-vous déjà vu quelque chose d’aussi beau ?
en: Have you ever seen anything so beautiful?

key: Qui est un bon toutou ? Qui ?

en: Bring me more, you wretched blob!

key: J’en ai besoin ! Juste une dernière fois !
en: I need it! One last time!
Nothing beats the thrill of fighting your archenemy!
You fought well, Belmont. Gloves off it is, then.
By killing you, I'll end your accursed bloodline!
I think I'd be bored if it wasn't for your family resisting me.
This Castle isn't big enough for the both of us!
Pushed to my limits by a mere copycat, me?!
You are but a bug to squash.
What are you hoping to achieve? I am the Dark Lord!
Nice try. Let's see how you do against this.
Bah, what a waste of time...
It has been a long time since someone stood against me like this.
Your ancestor was doing way better...
Well dodged, your predecessor would have been proud...
Your whole clan opposed me generation after generation and yet, here I still am.
Our two families used to be friends, a long time ago. If only you Belmonts had more ambition...
You're not on my level, small-time vampire!
The bad vampire hunter sees something and just hit it with his whip. The good vampire hunter sees something and hit it with his whip, but it's different...
You may have copied my appearance, but I'm not a mere vampire, I am Count Dracula!
Even my son can masquerade as a more convincing vampire...
I've been a good sport up until now, but this fight has been going on for too long. Die!
You can't compare to the Belmont.
I'm wasting my time, fighting with you.
You didn't think you could defeat me, did you?
So weak... how could such a worthless being defeat Death?
I've seen enough, time to perish now.
Argh! I'll kill you 9 times to make you pay if I have to!
Who brings their pet to a fateful fight, seriously?
Wounded by a mere cat?! Me?!
Bold of you to summon my own magic against me.
Stop using my familiars against their master!
Rah! Those Belmonts and their accursed whip!
Don't think that you just have to wield your ancestor's weapon to defeat me!
Cursed be Leon your forebear for creating this weapon!
I had forgotten the bite of this despicable whip...
Raaaaah! I'll make you pay for this!
When I've slaughtered you, I'll destroy this whip forever.
I had high hopes for this fight...
I'll wait for your descendant then.
Go back to sleep, my son.
I guess I'll see you in a few centuries?
You could have reigned over the world at my side... what a waste.
The night is still young, Adrian.
What the hell am I doing here?!
Does my liege need a break?

key: What a clever use of your environment, you should be proud.
en: What a clever use of your environment, you should be proud.

key: Les secrets des Architectes vous ont été révélés.
en: You have been initiated into the secrets of the Architects.

key: Appuyer longtemps pour vider le sac
en: Long press to empty the backpack.

key: Tire sur ::count:: ennemis proches à la fois, chaque tir infligeant ::+dps:: DPS.
en: Shoots at ::count:: nearby enemies at the same time. Each shot inflicts ::+dps:: DPS.

key: Tire des scies circulaires sur les ennemis proches et inflige {saignement@BL} (::+dps2:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec).
en: Fires spinning blades at nearby enemies, inflicting {bleeding@BL} (::+dps2:: DPS for ::duration:: sec).

key: Tire sur les ennemis proches. Vous infligez +::prct::% dégâts si vous êtes proche de la tourelle.
en: Shoots at nearby enemies. You inflict +::prct::% more damage if you're near the turret.

key: Tire sur les ennemis qui passent en dessous, infligeant un {coup critique@CC} aux ennemis souffrant de saignement ou d'empoisonnement.
en: Shoots enemies who pass beneath it, dealing {critical damage@CC} to poisoned enemies.

key: {Brûle@FI} les ennemis proches (::+dps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec).
Inflige {saignement@BL} (::+dotDps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec) aux ennemis qui marchent dessus.
en: Inflicts {bleeding@BL} (::+dotDps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec) on enemies that walk over it.

key: Lance ::count:: pièges qui {enracinent@RO} les ennemis et augmente les dégâts qu'ils subissent (::+dps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec).
en: Launches ::count:: traps that {root@RO} enemies increasing damage they take by ::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: seconds.

key: {Ralentit@IC} puis écrase violemment les ennemis pris dans sa zone d'effet.
en: {Slows down@IC} then violently crushes enemies caught in its zone.

key: Vous rend invisible pendant ::duration:: sec et attire les ennemis proches. Explose après ::duration:: sec. ou à la réactivation.
en: Turns you invisible for ::duration:: sec and attracts nearby enemies. Explodes after ::duration:: sec or upon reactivation.

key: Lance un éclair sur un ennemi proche et inflige {choc@EL}.
en: Shoots lightning at nearby enemies and inflicts {shock@EL}.

key: Shoots heavy cannonballs at nearby enemies. Short activation range and slow rate of fire.
en: Shoots heavy cannonballs at nearby enemies. Short activation range and slow rate of fire.

key: Rapide à utiliser, mais inflige des dégâts modérés.
en: Quick to use, but not super powerful.

key: Se sépare en ::count:: bombes (::+power:: dégâts chacune).
Attire les ennemis dans une large zone pendant quelques instants, puis explose en infligeant des dégâts {électriques@EL}.
en: Attracts enemies in a large area for a few moments, then explode, dealing {electrical@EL} damage.

key: {Enracine@RO} les ennemis proches (::+dps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec).
en: {Roots@RO} nearby enemies causing ::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: seconds.

key: Applique de {l'huile inflammable@FI} dans sa zone d'effet.
en: Spreads {inflammable oil@FI} in its area of effect.

key: Invoque ::count:: larves à votre service (cumulable jusqu'à ::ammo:: maximum)
en: Summons ::count:: biter to serve you (cumulative up to ::ammo:: max)

key: Énervez un monstre avec cet objet. Lorsqu'il lui reste ::prct::% de vie ou moins, utilisez "Extraction de schéma".
en: Use this to annoy a monster. When its health is down to ::prct::% or less, use "Blueprint Extractor".
Toss a holy water vial on the ground, creating a pillar of fire dealing damage quickly and {burning@FI} the enemies it hits.
I can holy take so much water!

key: Invoque un allié attaquant les ennemis proches.
en: Summon an ally to attack nearby enemies.

key: Crée une orbe dévastatrice qui se déplace lentement.
en: Creates a slow-moving but devastating orb.

key: Inflige des dégâts à toutes les cibles prises dedans. Change de direction quand elle rencontre un mur.
en: Inflicts damage on all targets caught inside. Changes direction when it hits a wall.

key: Lance des couteaux autour de vous provoquant {saignement@BL} (::+dps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec).
en: Launches a storm of knives around you, causing {bleeding@BL} (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec).

key: Augmente les dégâts que vous infligez de +::prct2::%. Vous subissez +::prct::% de dégâts sur cette période.
en: Increase the damage you deal by +::prct2::% for ::duration:: sec. You take +::prct::% damage during this time.

key: Sacrifie ::*prct::% de votre santé maximum pour vous permettre de récupérer ::prct2::% de PV par attaque et un bonus de vitesse pendant ::duration2:: secondes.
en: Sacrifices ::*prct::% of your maximum health to recover ::prct2::% of your HP per melee attack and a speed boost for ::duration2:: seconds.

key: Vous octroie ::*prct::% de votre vie manquante en {vie bonus@SH} et réduit de ::prct2::% les dégâts reçus pendant ::duration:: secondes.
en: Grants you ::*prct::% of your missing health as {bonus health@SH}. Reduces damage taken by ::prct2::% for ::duration:: seconds.

key: Détruit tous les projectiles proches. Le lanceur de ce projectile subit ::+power:: dégâts et est étourdit ::effectCharge:: secondes.
en: Destroys all nearby projectiles. The enemy who fired the projectile takes ::+power:: damage and is stunned for ::effectCharge:: seconds.

key: Attire un ennemi à vous. La prochaine attaque contre l'ennemi inflige +::*prct::% dégâts et l'étourdit pendant ::duration:: sec.
en: Pulls an enemy towards you. The next attack on this enemy inflicts +::*prct::% damage and stuns for ::duration:: sec.

key: Oui, comme Scorpion dans Mortal Kombat.
Vous téléporte dans le dos de l'ennemi. La prochaine attaque inflige +::+power:: dégâts.
en: Teleports you behind the enemy. The next attack inflicts +::+power:: damage.

key: Ralenti tous les ennemis pendant ::duration:: sec.
en: Slows down all enemies for ::duration:: sec.

key: Crée un large nuage infligeant des saignements et des empoisonnements (::+dps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec) pendant ::aoeDuration:: sec.
en: Creates a toxic cloud that lasts ::aoeDuration:: sec, inflicting bleed and poison damage (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec).

key: Inflige des dégâts aux cibles proches.
Repousse tous les ennemis proches. Si l'ennemi est projeté contre un mur, il subit +::+power2:: dégâts.
en: Repels all nearby enemies. If an enemy is thrown against a wall, it takes +::+power2:: damage.

key: Vous fait flotter en l'air pendant ::duration:: secondes et inflige des dégâts de zone ainsi que l'effet {choc@EL} (::+dps2:: DPS pendant ::*ShockAffectDuration:: sec).
en: Causes you to float in the air for ::duration:: seconds. Inflicts {electrical@EL} damage as well as {shock@EL} effect (::+dps2:: DPS for ::*ShockAffectDuration:: seconds) under you.

key: A utiliser sur un ennemi transformé par la "Bombe du Chasseur" ayant moins de ::prct::% de vie.
en: Use this on an enemy transformed by the "Hunter's Grenade" that has less than ::prct::% health left.

key: Révèle la carte des environs. Ne fonctionne qu'une seule fois.
en: Reveals your surroundings. Only works once.

key: Invoque un Grand-duc allié (::+dps:: dégâts/sec). Vous pouvez le renforcer (::+dps2:: dégâts/sec) en activant cette compétence à nouveau. Le Grand-duc disparaît si vous subissez des dégâts.
en: Summon a Great Owl pet (::+dps:: damage/sec). Activating this skill again will anger the Great Owl (::+dps2:: damage/sec). The Great Owl disappears if you take any damage.

key: Accélère vos déplacements de ::+prct::% pendant ::+duration:: sec quand vous tuez un ennemi.
en: Increase your movement speed by ::+prct::% for ::+duration:: sec when you kill an enemy.

key: Foncez en avant et infligez ::+power:: dégâts aux ennemis que vous traversez. Réactivez en fin de course pour revenir en sens contraire.
en: Dash forward and inflicts ::+power:: damage to the enemies on the way. Activate again to dash back.

key: Inflige ::+power:: dégâts à l'ennemi à portée que le géant juge le plus dangereux.
en: Inflict ::+power:: damage to the most dangerous enemy around... most dangerous ACCORDING to the Giant.

key: Propulsez-vous en l'air et frappez le sol pour infliger ::+power:: dégâts aux ennemis à proximité.
en: Leap in the air and violently land back on the ground to inflict ::+power:: damage to the enemies around.

key: Vous fait tourner sur vous même pour infliger des dégâts. Réactivez pour ajouter  ::+dps:: dégats/sec (jusqu'à 5 fois) et ::duration:: secondes. Chaque activation après la première coûte des cellules.
en: Spin the syringe around you to inflict damage. Activate again to add ::+dps:: damage/sec (up to 5 time) and ::duration:: secs, for a mere few cells.

key: Mon manège à moi c'est moi.
Make you invisble during ::duration:: seconds. The first attack while still invisble will do +::*prct::% additional damage.
en: Releases a cloud of smoke making you invisible for ::duration:: seconds. The first invisible attack inflicts +::*prct::% damage.

key: Invoque un compagnon champignon amical, gentil, attentionné… Charge et interrompt les enemis, infligeant ::+power:: et ::+power2:: additionnels si l'ennemi est projetté contre un mur. Activer à nouveau pour infliger ::+power3:: et perdre votre âme.
en: Spawns a friendly mushroom boi which charges and interrupts enemies inflicting ::+power:: damage and ::+power2:: extra damage if the enemy hits a wall. Trigger it again to inflict ::+power3:: damage and violate your soul.

key: Applique une armure de glace sur le héros qui absorbe une attaque et explose en {gelant@IC} les ennemis proches. Si aucune attaque n'est absorbée, l'armure explose au bout de ::duration2:: secondes.
en: Covers you in ice that absorbs one attack and explodes {freezing@IC} nearby enemies. If you don't take a hit it explodes after ::duration2:: seconds.

key: Posez jusqu'à ::count:: paratonnerre pour attirer la foudre et foudroyer les ennemis proches.
en: Place up to ::count:: lightning rods to attract lightning that strikes all enemies in between.

key: Revient vers vous automatiquement. Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} de plus en plus violents après chaque touche.
en: Comes back to you automatically. Inflicts increasingly severe {critical hits@CC} after each hit.

key: Parfait pour élaguer ce qui dépasse.
en: Perfect for pruning everything that sticks out.

key:
Activate to summon a flying sword for ::+dps:: dps, re-activate to switch for it from its flying form to its melee form. 

In flying form, the sword attacks and marks enemies (five marks maximum). The marks can be consumed in the melee form to inflict {critical damage@CC}. In its melee form, it also marks enemies when you attack mobs with it - these marks can be consumed in its flying form to inflict {critical damage@CC}.

The sword can stay up to 30 seconds in its flying form. Taking it in hand freeze the timer, consuming a mark reset it.
en: Summons a flying sword that will mark enemies, trigger it again to inflict critical hits on them while holding the weapon, and vice-versa! The sword will vanish after ::duration2:: sec if you don't hit the marked enemies.

key:
Summon a flying sword that will deal damage to nearby targets and mark them. ::+dps::
Consume the marks by grabbing the sword or it will get bored and go away!
en: Grab Serenade to deal {critical damage@CC} on marked enemies.

key: Parries all around you for ::+power:: damages. A succesful parry resets the cooldown.
en: Parries all around you dealing ::+power:: damage. A successful parry resets the cooldown.
Crush a flask on your forehead, dealing low damage to yourself.
Smashing red stuff in your own face is NEVER a good idea, ask the people of Tristram.
Turn into a chicken for a brief moment, firing several explosive eggs around you.

key:
Summon a Leghugger that attacks your enemies, inflicting {critical hits@CC} on bleeding targets. Re-activate to make it attack in a circle around itself, making enemies hit {bleed@BL}.

The creature feeds by attacking your enemies. Once sated, it evolves into its stronger adult state.
en:
Summon a Leghugger that attacks your enemies, inflicting {critical hits@CC} on bleeding targets. Re-activate to make it attack in a circle around itself, making enemies hit {bleed@BL}.

The creature feeds by attacking your enemies. Once sated, it evolves into its stronger adult state.
Bloodthirsty and cute, what more could you ask?
Bloodthirsty and cute, what more could you ask?

key: Summon an adult Leghugger that attacks your enemies, inflicting {critical hits@CC} on bleeding targets. Re-activate to make it attack in a circle around itself, making enemies hit {bleed@BL}.
en: Summon an adult Leghugger that attacks your enemies, inflicting {critical hits@CC} on bleeding targets. Re-activate to make it attack in a circle around itself, making enemies hit {bleed@BL}.
Bloodthirsty and cute, what more could you ask?
Bloodthirsty and cute, what more could you ask?

{Draw@CC}: you gain ::*life:: {bonus health@SH} that persists indefinitely. 
{Passive@CC}: Each successful {parry@PA} grants ::*count:: {bonus health@SH} for ::duration2:: sec and deal ::prct::% more damage.
{Discard@CC}: remove all current {bonus health@SH} and deal damage depending on the quantity removed.
At the core of an ancient strategy called "the 999 block".

{Passive@CC}: Your melee attacks {poison@TO} the enemies they hit.
{Discard@CC}: nearby enemies lose all their damage-over-time stacks then are dealt the remaining damage of these effects.
You can wait for the last straw to break the camel back... or push the poor beast yourself!

{Draw@CC}: creates a lightning orb that gravitates around you, dealing ::+power:: damage on impact.
{Passive@CC}: Each time you use your other skill, creates an additional orb (max: ::limit:: orbs).
{Discard@CC}: destroys all your active orbs. Thunder strikes a nearby enemy for each orb destroyed that way, dealing ::+power2:: damage.
Less hazardous when wearing a Faraday Outfit.

{Passive@CC}: You avoid the first damage source dealt to you. This effect recharges when you kill ::count:: enemies.
{Discard@CC}: you become immune to all sources of damage for ::duration:: sec.
You don't even know that I'm still not dead!
Taunts an enemy, causing it to frantically pursue you for ::duration2:: sec but take ::prct::% more damage from your melee attacks.
Requires Language (Old times) or Language (Foul) mastery.
Throws a magic stone that bounces on surfaces and moves faster after each bounce. Deals {critical hits@CC} and accelerates sharply after passing through you.
The words "Digital Video Disc" are engraved on the stone. Probably some sort of unholy incantation. Oddly satisfying when it hits corners.

Summons Maria's cat on your shoulder. He often leaves it to go and wander around, scratching enemies he crosses. Can be reactivated to make the cat jump in front of you and unleash a flurry of slashes dealing {critical damage@CC}.
Such a vase-busting, curtain-scratching, armor-defiling little creature is at peak efficiency in an old Castle like Dracula's.
Throws ::count:: bats that pierce through enemies and deal {critical damage@CC} once they have gone through at least one target.
Quick, throw them before they fill your pockets with guano!
Throws a cross in front of you. It returns after a few seconds, dealing {critical damage@CC} when spinning in place or on the way back.
"Don't you dare cross me, Belmont!". The pun didn't save Dracula.

Calls down a ray of vengeful light on the nearest enemy dealing {critical damage@CC} if you are not cursed. Targets killed by this skill purge you of ::count:: stacks of curse instead of 1. Summons 1 additional ray per 5 curses you have.
Whatever is up there, now would be the time to help!

key: Peut servir à tuer des gens.
Les dégâts augmentent jusqu'à +::prct::% tant que vous enchainez les coups. Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} après ::count:: coups enchainés.
en: Damage increases up to +::prct::% when you strike repeatedly. Inflicts {critical hits@CC} after ::count:: successive hits.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si vous avez subi des dégâts il y a moins de ::duration:: sec, ou si vous êtes maudit(e).
en: Inflict a {critical hit@CC} if you took damage less than ::duration:: sec ago, or if you're cursed.

key: Une arme rouillée dont la puissance se révèle dans les moments difficiles.
en: A rusty weapon that reveals its power when things get tough.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} quand vous frappez dans le dos.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} when you stab your enemy in the back.

key: Légère mais mortelle si elle maniée comme il faut.
en: Light but deadly if you know how to use it.
Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} on the 3rd consecutive strike.

key: Deux dagues pour le prix d'une, toujours plus de violence.
en: Two daggers for the price of one. Slice and dice... guaranteed to please.
The second and third hits are {critical@CC}.

key: Lourde et lente, mais tellement violente.
en: Slow and heavy, but deliciously vicious.

key: Projette les ennemis et les bombes.
Tout objet peut devenir une arme mortelle avec une vélocité suffisante.
en: Any object can become a deadly weapon if it's moving fast enough...

key: Vous tue immédiatement si vous subissez le moindre dégât.
Alors comme ça, vous voulez la jouer difficile ?
en: So you like to play hardball, do ya?

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si la cible {saigne@BL} ou est {empoisonnée@TO}.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the target is {bleeding@BL} or {poisoned@TO}.

key: Conçue pour appuyer là où ça fait mal.
Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si votre mouvement est accéléré.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if you have an active speed buff.

key: Prendre son temps ? Quel blague. Frapper vite et fort, voilà la recette qui marche.
en: Forget about taking your time. To get real results, strike hard and fast.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si la victime est un élite ou un boss.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the victim is an elite enemy or a boss.

key: Projète des fragments métalliques infligeant environ ::+dps:: dégâts/sec.
en: Metal shards burst from the axes when you strike enemies, inflicting approximately ::+dps:: damage.

key: Provoque des ondes de choc terrestres qui {enracinent@RO} les victimes.
en: Provokes terrestrial shock waves that {root@RO} victims.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} lorsque vous touchez plusieurs cibles à la fois.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} when you strike several targets at the same time.

key: Une arme offrant une grande allonge au détriment de la rapidité.
Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si la victime est contre un mur.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the victim is up against a wall.

key: Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} pendant ::duration:: sec si vous tuez rapidement ::count:: ennemis avec cette arme.
en: Inflicts {critical hits@CC} for ::duration:: sec if you quickly kill ::count:: enemies with this weapon.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} juste après une roulade ou une parade.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} immediately after a roll or a parry.

key: Le premier coup permet de passer dans le dos des ennemis. Les coups suivants infligent des {coups critiques@CC} aux enemis traversés ainsi.
en: The first attack pierces the enemy, placing you behind it. Your next attacks inflict {critical hits@CC}.

key: Tu me vois, tu me vois plus.
en: Now you see me, now you don't.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si la cible est étourdie, {gelée@IC} ou {enracinée@RO}.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the victim is stunned, {frozen@IC} or {rooted@RO}.

key: Projette les ennemis, infligeant des dégats de zone à l'endroit où ils retombent.  ::+power2:: dégâts supplémentaires s'ils sont projetés contre un mur. Le dernier coup est capable de repousser n'importe quel adversaire.
en: Knocks back enemies, dealing damage where they land. Deals ::+power2:: extra damage if the enemy hits a wall. The final strike in the combo will knock back any enemy.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si le coup de pied interrompt une attaque.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the kick interrupts an attack.

key: Le dernier coup inflige des dégâts de zone et repousse les ennemis. ::+power2:: dégâts supplémentaires s'ils sont projetés contre un mur.
en: The last hit damages all enemies around you and pushes them back. ::+power2:: additional damage if they are thrown into a wall.

key: Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} si la victime a moins de ::prct::% PV.
en: Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if the victim has less than ::prct::% HP.

key: Ignore les boucliers. Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si le bout du fouet touche l'ennemi.
en: Ignores shields. Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the tip of the whip strikes the enemy.

key: La famille Valmont recommande ce fouet.
en: Popularized by the well-dressed Baron Valmont du Cul.

key: Ignore les boucliers, attire les victimes et inflige un {coup critique@CC} au 3ème coup.
en: Ignores shields, pulls victims toward you and inflicts a {critical hit@CC} on the 3rd strike.

key: Applique de {l'huile inflammable@FI} sur les ennemis et inflige des {coups critiques@CC} pendant ::duration:: sec après avoir touché un ennemi en feu.
en: Douses the enemy with {inflammable oil@FI} and inflict {critical hits@CC} during ::duration:: sec after hitting an enemy on fire.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} lorsque vous avez moins de ::prct::% de vie ou plus de ::prct::% de Mal-être.
en: Inflict a {critical hit@CC} when you have less than ::prct::% health or more than ::prct::% Malaise.

key: L'arme de choix des combattants qui aiment vivre dangereusement.
en: The weapon of choice for fighters who like to live dangerously.

key: Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} si vous n'avez subit aucun dégât depuis ::lock:: sec.
en: Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if you haven't taken damage for at least ::lock:: seconds.

key: Un coup maintenu inflige un {coup critique@CC} et projette une trainée de flamme infligeant ::+power:: dégâts.
en: Hold the attack to inflict a {critical hit@CC} and create a flaming trail dealing ::+power:: damage.

key: Laissez le Concierge vous donner un coup de main.
en: The Concierge was always ready to give an extra hand.

key: Ignore les boucliers et vous projette vers l'ennemi. Inflige un {coup critique@CC} après avoir été projeté.
en: Ignores shields and projects you towards the enemy and inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if you attack again while bumped.

key: Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} si l'adversaire vous fait face.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the enemy is facing you.

key: Tout vient à point à qui sait attendre.
Repel projectiles (not grenades though)  to inflict {critical hits@CC} during ::duration:: seconds.
en: Repelling a projectile causes you to inflict {critical hits@CC} for ::duration:: seconds.

key: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if you have hit with the other claw before.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if you previously used the other claw.
Recovered from the stinking carcass of Mama Tick. Might come in handy.
Pillaged from the rotting corpse of Mama Tick. Now go, give her a taste of her own medicine.

key: Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if you strike at the right time. The last hit repeats indefinitely if you keep the tempo going.
en: Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if you strike at the right time. The last hit repeats indefinitely if you keep the tempo going.
Hey, get rhythm when you get the blues! Come on, get rhythm when you get the blues...

key: Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} en frappant des ennemis bestiaux ou pendant ::duration:: secondes après avoir détruit une porte.
en: Inflict {critical hits@CC} when hitting bestial enemies or for ::duration:: seconds after destroying a door.

key: Étonnamment efficace pour se débarasser des parasites.
en: Surprisingly effective to get rid of parasites.

key: Teleports you to the closest target. {Empoisonne@TO} les victimes (::+dps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec). Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} si la victime a plus de ::count:: marqueurs de poison.
en: Teleports you to the nearest target. {Poisons@TO} victims (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec). Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if the target has more than ::count:: poison marks.

key: Le premier coup permet de {parrer@PA} les coups au corps à corps. Le combo inflige des {coups critiques@CC} après une parade réussie.
en: The first hit allows you to {parry@PA} melee hits. The combo inflicts {critical hits@CC} after a successful parry.

key: Tuer un ennemi avec la Lanterne pour annexer son âme. Le dernier coup du combo arrache une âme aux Boss.
en: Kill an enemy to gather its soul. The last combo hit snatches a soul from Bosses.

key: Consume marks applied by the Flying Sword to deal {critical damages@CC}.
en: Hit enemies marked by Serenade to deal {critical damage@CC}.

key: Lightning fast slice through inflicting hits to crossed enemies
en: Hold to dash through enemies in front of you inflicting {critical hits@CC}.

key: Tuez un ennemi avec le dernier coup du combo pour l'enterrer sous une pierre tombale et condamner les ennemis proches.
en: Kill an enemy with the last hit to bury it under a tombstone and doom nearby enemies.

key: Enchaînez le dernier coup du combo pour infliger des {dégâts critiques@CC}.
en: Repeat the last hit combo to inflict {critical damage@CC}.

key: Chargez l'attaque pour frapper fort, mais le gourdin se brisera pour ::duration:: secondes.
en: Strike harder by charging your attack, but the Toothpick will be broken for ::duration:: seconds.
Reverts to initial form after ::autoTransformAfter:: seconds.
The third attack uses the pistol to bump and inflict {critical damage@CC} to nearby enemies.
Deals {critical damage@CC} depending on the number of gun marks on the target. Recharges Hard Light Gun's ammo.
An elegant weapon for a more civilized age.
Can attack while moving and upward. Attacking downward while airborne cause you to bounce on your enemies, dealing {critical damage@CC}.
My life's work achieved... What more is left...?
Hitting with the second attack enables a whirlwind attack that deals {critical damage@CC}.
You don't want to have one to pick with that young skeleton.

key: The third attack is a charge that inflicts {critical damage@CC} after a few moments. Interrupt it with the last attack to deal {critical damage@CC}.

key: The last attack throws the target behind you, bumping other enemies it hits. Enemies thrown on walls are dealt {critical damage@CC}.
en: The last attack throws the target behind you, bumping other enemies it hits. Enemies thrown on walls are dealt {critical damage@CC}.
You'll get hooked on throwing enemies on the walls!

key: The third attack throws the shark, {rooting@RO} the enemy and causing it to {bleed@BL}. Inflicts {critical hits@CC} on {rooted@RO} targets.
en: The third attack throws the shark, {rooting@RO} the enemy and causing it to {bleed@BL}. Inflicts {critical hits@CC} on {rooted@RO} targets.
The first weapon that moonlights as a terrible sea predator.

key: The first attack makes you jump forward. Hitting with this attack causes your next combo with this weapon to deal {critical damage@CC}.
en: The first attack makes you jump forward. Hitting with this attack causes your next combo with this weapon to deal {critical damage@CC}.
Stylish yet impractical. How was she able to use it with such deadly accuracy?!

key: The third attack throws the ball and the fourth recalls it.
en: The third attack throws the ball and the fourth recalls it.
I never hit so hard in love.

key: Attacks that hit a target also slice through reality, hitting anything on their path again.
en: Attacks that hit a target also slice through reality, hitting anything on their path again.
Graceful and deadly, just like Her.
Inflicts {critical hits@CC} for ::duration:: seconds after picking up gold.
Hits cause their target to drop ::count:: gold. Inflicts {critical damage@CC} if you have more than ::bonus:: gold.
You charge forward. Upon hitting a target, you bounce into the air spinning. Bouncing on an enemy deals {critical damage@CC} and let's you charge again.
Attacking a stunned or {rooted@RO} enemy lets you strike frantically, dealing {critical damage@CC}.
Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the enemy is facing you.
Successful attacks also create two falling stars that strike another target if possible, dealing {critical damage@CC}.
Along with other famous swords, this can be forged into the Zenith.
If a target is in front of you in mid range, teleports you near it and attacks it, dealing a {critical damage@CC}.
"Acquire the blade of the dhampir, use it against the vampire sire!" says the proverb.
A brutal whip with a star-shaped head. Can be held to spin the whip along with your movement. Deals {critical hits@CC} with the spike ball.
Will give you a strong wrist.
If the second attack of the weapon hits a target, throws a projectile on a rotary trajectory, dealing {critical damage@CC} increasing with each new hit.
Can be transformed in between two attacks to deal {critical damage@CC} for the next ::duration:: seconds.
Can be transformed in between two attacks to deal {critical damage@CC} for the next ::duration:: seconds.
Transforms the Whip Sword, enabling it to deal {critical damage@CC} for the next ::duration:: seconds.
The mythical weapon of the Belmont clan! Ignores shields. Deals {critical damage@CC} to {burning@FI} enemies. Enemies killed by this weapon {burn@FI} the ground under them.
I have come here to eat chicken and crucify vampires... and I'm all out of chicken.
Forces the spirit of enemies you kill to help you. They explode on nearby targets, dealing {critical damage@CC} in proportion to the reanimated target's maximum health.
Being dead is no excuse to avoid working overtime!
The mythical weapon of the Belmont clan! Ignores shields.
Alternates between both scythes, dealing {critical strikes@CC} starting with the second hit.
Bumps and inflicts {critical damage@CC} to nearby enemies.
An attack that kills an enemy also kills every other target hit at the same time.
The first hit throws the enemy in the air. Deal {critical damage@CC} to targets that are not grounded.
Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if the victim has less than ::prct::% HP. Curses you if the attack doesn't kill its target.
If death is a gift, then you're Santa Claus.

key: Les munitions reviennent quand vous achevez les ennemis.
en: Ammo comes back after enemies are killed.

key: C'est le jouet du fils du geolier. On doit bien pouvoir tuer quelques trucs avec ça.
en: The Jailer's son was getting pretty good at hunting rats with this...
Shoots ::count:: arrows at the same time.

key: Munitions illimitées. Le dernier tir inflige un {coup critique@CC}.
en: Unlimited ammo. Last shot is a {critical hit@CC}!

key: "On n'a jamais trop de flèches" - Legolas
en: "You can never have too many arrows" - Legolas

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} à longue portée.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} at long range.

key: Dévastateur à longue portée, c'est le sniper en bois.
en: Slow, but devastating at long range. A sniper’s delight.

key: Traverse ses victimes et tire en rafale quand elle est maintenue. Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} aux ennemis derrière la première cible.
en: Fires through enemies and keeps shooting when held down. Inflict {critical hits@CC} to the targets behind the first enemy.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} à courte portée.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} at close range.

key: Un arc spécialement conçu pour le corps à corps.
en: A bow specially designed for hand-to-hand combat.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si la cible a ::count:: flèches ou plus dans le corps.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the target has ::count:: or more arrows stuck in its body.

key: La rapidité au détriment de la précision.
en: Speed at the cost of precision.

key: Tire plusieurs carreaux à la fois à courte portée.
en: Shoots several short-range bolts at once.

key: Recharge l'arbalète lourde. La prochaine volée de carreau inflige des {coups critiques@CC}.
en: Reload the Heavy Crossbow. The next shot inflicts a {critical hit@CC}.

key: Tire rapidement des carreaux infligeant des {coups critiques@CC} sur les cibles {enracinées@RO}.
en: Rapid fires bolts inflicting {critical hits@CC} on {rooted@RO} targets.

key: Tire une volée de carreaux {enracinants@RO} et infligeants ::+dps:: DPS pendant ::duration:: secondes.
en: Fires a volley of bolts {rooting@RO} enemies and inflicting ::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: seconds.

key: Tire un carreau perçant. Inflige un {coup critique@CC} et retire les flèches plantées sur les cibles {gelées@IC}.
en: Fires piercing bolts, inflicting {critical hits@CC} and returning bolts lodged in {frozen@IC} enemies.

key: Les carreaux explosent en zone. Un ennemi touché par un carreau subit un {coup critique@CC}.
en: Bolts explode in the area of effect. Any enemy hit by a bolt suffers a {critical wound@CC}.

key: Provoque {saignement@BL} (::+dps:: DPS pendant ::duration:: sec). Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si la cible {saigne@BL} ou est {empoisonnée@TO}.
en: Causes {bleeding@BL} (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: seconds). Deals a {critical hit@CC} if the target is {bleeding@BL} or {poisoned@TO}.

key: {Enracine@RO} la victime. La hache inflige ::+power:: dégâts lorsqu'elle est rappelée.
en: {Roots@RO} the victim. Deals ::+power:: damage when recalled.

key: Empale tous les ennemis sur son passage. S'ils sont proches d'un mur, ils subissent ::+power2:: dégâts supplémentaires. L'arme doit être ramassée (sinon elle revient après ::duration:: sec). Réactiver pour se téléporter au javelot.
en: Impales all enemies in its path. If they're close to a wall they take ::+power2:: extra damage. The javelin must be retrieved (if not, it comes back automatically after ::duration:: seconds). Reactivate to teleport to the javelin.
Marks the enemy, who then takes +::+power:: additional damage every ::effectCD:: sec for ::duration:: sec. If the enemy dies, the mark spreads.

key: Tu ne le sais pas encore, mais tu es déjà mort.
en: You don't know it yet, but you’re already dead.

key: Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si la flèche est tirée au bon moment.
en: Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the arrow is shot at the right moment.

key: Provoque {saignement@BL} (::+dps:: DPS pendant ::duration:: sec). Cible automatiquement l'ennemi le plus proche.
en: Causes {bleeding@BL} (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec). Automatically targets the nearest enemy.

key: Inflige ::prct::% des dégats aux ennemis proches de votre cible. Inflige {choc@EL} (::+dps2:: DPS en zone pendant ::*ShockAffectDuration:: sec). Ignore les boucliers.
en: Ignores shields and inflicts ::prct::% of base damage on nearby enemies. Also inflicts ::+dps2:: {shock@EL} DPS around the target for ::*ShockAffectDuration:: seconds.

key: {Brûle@FI} les ennemis et le sol (::+dps:: DPS pendant ::duration:: sec).
en: {Burns@FI} enemies and the ground (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec).

key: {Ralenti@IC} les ennemis pendant ::duration:: sec. Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} sur les cibles dans l'eau ou couvertes {d'huile@FI}.
en: {Slows down@IC} enemies during ::duration:: sec. Inflicts {critical hits@CC} on targets standing in water or covered in {oil@FI}.

key: Lance plusieurs projectiles enflammés. Inflige des {coups critiques@CC} sur une cible couverte {d'huile@FI}.
en: Launches multiple flaming projectiles. Inflicts {critical damage@CC} on targets covered in {oil@FI}.

key: Maintenir pour infliger des {coups critiques@CC}. Inflige {choc@EL} (::+dps2:: DPS en zone pendant ::*ShockAffectDuration:: sec).
en: Hold to deal {critical hits@CC}. Inflicts ::+dps2:: {shock@EL} DPS around the target for ::*ShockAffectDuration:: seconds.

key: {Brûle@FI} les ennemis et le sol à courte portée. Inflige des {dégâts critiques@CC} sur de {l'huile@FI}.
en: {Burns@FI} enemies and the ground surface in range. Inflicts {critical hits@CC} when {oil@FI} is present.
Toasts enemies to a rich golden brown.

key: {Gèle@IC} les ennemis devant vous. Aucun dégât si la cible est déjà {gelée@IC}.
en: {Freezes@IC} enemies in front of you. No damage if the target is already {frozen@IC}.

key: Cible automatiquement l'ennemi le plus proche.
{Poison@TO} its victims (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec). Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if you hit enemies in the back.
en: {Poison@TO} its victims (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec). Inflicts {critical hits@CC} if you hit enemies in the back.

key: Tire un tonneau explosif. Inflige un {coup critique@CC} si le tonneau a rebondi contre un mur avant d'exploser.
en: Launches an explosive barrel. Inflicts a {critical hit@CC} if the barrel bounces off or has been reflected back and forth before exploding.

key: Charger pour lancer plusieurs âmes comme des projectiles. Si ::count:: âmes ou plus sont lancées en même temps, elles infligent des {coups critiques@CC}.
en: Charge to shoot souls as projectiles. If more than ::count:: souls are shot at the same time, they inflict {critical hits@CC}.
Marks its targets to make Hard Light Sword deal {critical damage@CC} to them. Ammo doesn't recharge passively.
Not that clumsy or random, though.

key: Shoots cards in various patterns. The fourth hit recalls all the cards, dealing {critical damage@CC}.
en: Shoots cards in various patterns. The fourth hit recalls all the cards, dealing {critical damage@CC}.
Using cards as a weapon is quite the gambit...

key:
Fires large arrows that push enemies. Stuns and inflicts
{critical damage@CC} if it bumps its target into a wall or another enemy.
en: Fires large arrows that push enemies. Stuns and inflicts {critical damage@CC} if it bumps its target into a wall or another enemy.
Surprisingly easy to use, considering the tree trunk-sized arrows it fires.
Fires ::count:: gold from your pockets dealing {critical damage@CC}. Won’t fire if you can’t pay.
Shut up and shoot my money!

key: Fires homing arrows. Arrows deal more damage if they hit the same enemy.
en: Fires homing arrows that deal more damage if they hit the same enemy.

key: Just close your eyes and shoot!
en: Just close your eyes and shoot!
Stuns any enemy it hits. Recharge 1 ammo every time you kill an enemy.
Vase, flower pot, bottle, knife,... No matter what you can grab, as long as you can throw it, you're game.
Bounces on nearby targets, dealing more and more damage each time and dealing {critical damage@CC} after ::bonus:: bounces.
The lower your health, the more attacks this weapon has in its combo. Deals {critical damage@CC} starting from the third hit.
Can also double as domestic incense, even in a foul-smelling prison.
Throws an axe on a parabolic trajectory, dealing {critical damage@CC} during its descent.
Axe as a bridge between two universes
Rolls the head on the ground, {petrifying@PT} enemies it hits. When it stops or upon reactivation, it yells, projecting nearby enemies in the air.
Look me in the eyes when I'm talking to you!
Fires an indirect projectile that curses you ::count:: time if it hits at least one enemy.

key:
Maintenir pour absorber une partie des dégâts.
Appuyer brièvement pour tenter une {parade@PA} et annuler les dégâts.
en:
Hold to absorb partial damage.
Tap to try to {parry@PA} and block all damage.

key: Vos attaques au corps-à-corps infligent ::prct2::% de dégâts supplémentaires pendant ::duration:: secondes après une {parade@PA} réussie.
en: Melee attacks inflict ::prct2::% extra damage for ::duration:: seconds after a successful {parry@PA}.

key: Les larmes de la communauté sont gravées dans le bois, côté intérieur.
en: The tears of the community are engraved upon the inside of this shield.

key: Etourdit les ennemis bloqués. Durée de l'effet accrue si {parade@PA} réussie.
en: Stuns blocked enemies. Stuns last longer if a {parry@PA} is successful.

key: Les attaques bloquées infligent des dégâts aux ennemis proches. {Coups critiques@CC} si {parade@PA} réussie.
en: Blocked attacks inflict damage on nearby enemies. {Critical damage@CC} if {parry@PA} is successful.

key: Les attaques bloquées repoussent les ennemis. Si l'ennemi est projeté contre un mur, il subit +::+power2:: dégâts. Effet doublé si {parade@PA} réussie.
en: Blocking attacks knocks enemies back, they take +::+power2:: damage if they hit a wall. Double damage for a {parry@PA}.

key: Absorbe plus de dégâts. Génère un champ de force (::duration:: sec) si {parade@PA} au corps à corps réussie.
en: Absorbs more damage. Generates a force field for ::duration:: sec on a successful melee {parry@PA}.

key: Bloque les attaques tout en chargeant en avant.
Les attaques bloquées infligent {saignement@BL} (::+dps:: DPS sur ::duration:: sec). Effet étendu aux ennemis proches si {parade@PA} réussie.
en: Blocked attacks inflict {bleeding@BL} (::+dps:: DPS for ::duration:: sec). Effect extended to nearby enemies on a successful {parry@PA}.

key: Une {parade@PA} réussie fait tomber les dents des ennemis (1 par ennemi). Transforme les flèches en or.
en: A successful {parry@PA} knocks out enemies' teeth (1 per enemy) and transforms arrows into gold.

key: Inflige d'importants dégâts aux ennemis bloqués.
en: Inflicts major damage on blocked enemies.

key: Ne peut être maintenu. Les grenades et tirs bloqués sont renvoyés avec plus de puissance.
en: Cannot be held up. Blocked grenades and shots are returned with added power.

key: Génère un champ de force temporaire tant qu'il est maintenu. Il se regénère lentement quand le bouclier n'est plus maintenu. Les {parades@PA} accélèrent le processus.
en: Generates a temporary force field when held up. It regenerates slowly when the shield is not held up. {Parries@PA} speed up the process.

key: Inflige ::+dps:: DPS {électriques@EL} devant vous quand il est maintenu ou tout autour de vous pendant ::duration:: secondes après une {parade@PA} réussie. Réutiliser le bouclier déchargera l'énergie d'un seul coup, étourdissant les ennemis. Inflige {choc@EL} (::+dps2:: DPS en zone pendant ::*ShockAffectDuration:: sec).
en: Inflicts ::+dps:: {electric@EL} DPS in front of you for ::duration:: seconds when blocking, or all around you after a successful {parry@PA}. Use again to stun all nearby enemies. Inflicts ::+dps2:: {shock@EL} DPS around you for ::*ShockAffectDuration:: seconds.

key: {Parrer@PA} un coup {gèle@IC} les enemis proche. Les projectiles renvoyés {gêlent@IC} les ennemis au contact.
en: {Parrying@PA} an attack {freezes@IC} nearby enemies. Reflected projectiles {freeze@IC} enemies they hit.
Can be used to attack in melee. Deals {critical damage@CC} after a parry.
When Alucard uses it in combat, you could say that the dhampir strikes back.

key: Rien de notable, si ce n'est une odeur persistante de rat crevé.
en: Nothing worth mentioning, except maybe a vague whiff of dead rat...

key: Un bel objet habilement dissimulé sous vos vêtements, pour que les graphistes aient moins de boulot.
en: A beautiful object skillfully hidden under your clothes to save the artists some work.

key: Vous sauve la vie UNE fois (inefficace contre les Malédictions).
en: Saves your life ONCE (doesn't work against Curses).

key: Qui a dit qu'on ne pouvait pas tromper la mort ?
en: Who says you can't cheat death?

key: Clé du quartier de haute sécurité
Trouvée dans un mur, reste à savoir à quoi elle sert.
en: Found in a wall. Who knows what it’s for?
