Jour 1 : 22
Jour 1 : 19"
Sûrement une partie de l'quipement de ce gardien.
en: Must be part of this guardian's equipment.

key: Elles sont malheureusement un peu grandes pour que je m'en équipe.
en: Unfortunately, they're a little too big for me to be able to use them.
The swords seem to be floating...

key: ...mais au toucher, je les sens immobiles.
en: ... but when I touch them, they feel solidly in place.

key: Je n'aime pas du tout cet endroit.
en: I really don't like this place.

key: Encore cette sensation... de flottement, comme si tout était ralenti et accéléré en même temps.
en: That sensation again... like I'm floating, as if everything was speeding up and slowing down at the same time.

key: Woah, ça donne un peu la gerbe quand même !
en: Whoa, sort makes you feel like puking, huh?

key: Cet alchimiste a vraiment étalé ses affaires dans toute l'île !
en: The alchemist really scattered his stuff all over the island!
... OK, so what's he on about this time?

key: Avec tout le respect que je lui dois, elle ne pourra pas contenir le Mal-être 'éternellement'.”
en: With all due respect, it can't contain the Malaise 'forever'."

key: Un ordre frappé du sceau du Roi.
en: An order stamped with the King's seal.

key: "Castaing, ceci est une consigne directe qui doit rester entre vous et moi...
en: "Castaing, this is a direct order that must remain between you and me...

key: Veillez à ne plus contrôler les entrées de la prison jusqu'à nouvel ordre."
en: Stop checking the prison entrances until further notice."

key: Tous ces papiers sont signés par Castaing.
en: All these papers are signed by Castaing.

key: Aucun doute sur le fait qu'il soit haut placé dans cette prison.
en: A high-ranking prison officer, no doubt about it.

key: Il se gardait quelques piécettes de côté pour les coups durs ?
en: Did he set aside a few pennies for a rainy day?

key: En tout cas ce directeur était préparé au combat.
en: In any case, the warden was prepared for combat.

key: "La construction des ponts, de l'antiquité à nos jours"
en: "Bridge building from antiquity to the present day."

key: "Manager ses soldats : comment gagner leur respect sans utiliser la torture."
en: "Managing soldiers: How to earn their respect without using torture."

key: "Gérer l'entrée d'une prison en 10 leçons (la leçon 8 va vous étonner !)"
en: "Managing prison entrances in 10 easy lessons (lesson 8 will shock you!)"

key: Le directeur de la prison a des bureaux un peu partout ?
en: Did the prison warden have desks all over the place?

key: Et encore de l'or... Plus que la dernière fois.
en: And more gold... More than the last time.
A direct order from the King.

key: Quand votre Roi indique "consigne directe qui doit rester entre vous et moi", cela signifie que vous ne devez pas accrocher ces consignes sur les murs à la vue de tous !
en: When your King writes of a 'direct order that must remain between you and me', that means you mustn't post these orders on the walls for all to see!

key: Quoi qu'il en soit : ne laissez plus les prisonniers sortir de la prison, même ceux qu ont purgé leur peine."
en: In any case: do not allow the prisoners to leave the prison, not even when they have served their time."

key: Je connais pas beaucoup ce Castaing, mais je l'aime déjà.
en: I don't know much about this Castaing, but I like him already.

key: "Bon Castaing, laissez tomber pour les ordres affichés au mur.
en: "All right, Castaing, forget about the orders posted on the walls.

key: Il y a plus urgent : les villageois tentent de traverser le pont pour rejoindre le village.
en: There is something more important: the villagers are trying to cross the bridge to the village.

key: Arrêtez-les et reconduisez-les dans les cellules...
en: Arrest them and take them back to their cells...

key: Une lettre du directeur... apparement pour ses officiers.
en: A letter from the warden... apparently to his officers.

key: "Messieurs, j'éprouve toutes les difficultés du monde à vous rédiger cet ordre.
en: "Gentlemen, it is extremely difficult for me to draft this order.

key: Un mal soudain m'empêche de vous aider à maintenir la situation stable sur le pont.
en: A sudden illness prevents me from helping you maintain a stable situation on the bridge.

key: Je vous rejoindrai prestement dès que la nausée sera passée... et que mes bras auront arrêté de gonfler.
en: I will join you promptly once the nausea has passed... and once my arms have stopped swelling.

key: La situation est encore sous contrôle, ne perdez pas espoir !
en: The situation is still under control, do not lose hope!
We can do it if we stand together!

key: Rien n'est impossible si nous travaillons en équipe !
en: Nothing is impossible if we work as a team!

key: L'union fait la force, et nous sommes unis dans l'adversité !
en: Unity is strength, and we are united in adversity!

key: Je suis fier de vous, nous pouvons braver cette épreuve !
en: I am proud of you. We can overcome this trial!

key: Je crois en vous, je crois en nous !
en: I believe in you, I believe in us!"

key: Ca sonne comme une leçon de "Manager ses soldats : comment gagner leur respect sans utiliser la torture."
en: Sounds like a lesson from "Managing soldiers: How to earn their respect without using torture".

key: Une lettre marquée du sceau du Roi, soigneusement pliée au fond du coffre.
en: A letter stamped with the King's seal, carefully folded at the back of the safe.

key: Castaing avait enfin compris pour l'affichage, on dirait.
en: Looks like Castaing finally got the message about posting orders.

key: "Bon sang, combien vais-je devoir vous donner pour que le travail soit fait ? Bouclez-moi ce pont une bonne fois pour toutes, c'est une question de vie ou de mort !"
en: "Dammit, how much must I give you to do the job properly? Shut down that bridge once and for all, it's a question of life and death!"

key: Oh et ce n'est pas tout.
Des gens se sont battus... Ou bien quelqu'un est devenu incontrôlable.
en: There was a fight... or someone lost all control.

key: Un corps ouvert...et une substance orange qui en sort.
en: A gaping body... and an orange substance oozing out of it.

key: Ca ne ressemble pas à une petite grippe.
en: This was more than just a touch of flu.

key: Oh. J'ai peur de comprendre de qui il s'agit.
en: Oh. I'm afraid I know who it was.

key: Sacré Castaing, toujours prêt au combat !
en: Good old Castaing, always ready for battle!

key: Une porte que je n'aurais pas à défoncer !
en: Hey, a door I don't have to knock down!

key: "L'agent de la sureté interne pénitenciaire Guitou consigne par la présente...
en: "Internal prison security agent Guitou hereby reports...

key: ..le signalement d'une créature à fortiori de grande taille récemment sortie du bureau du Directeur Castaing.
en: ... that a creature observed to be of large size was sighted emerging from Warden Castaing's office.

key: ..L'absence de ce dernier nous permet de supposer que Mr le Directeur aurait, à fortiori, été tué dans l'exercice de ses fonctions.
en: ... The absence of said warden leads us to conclude that he was almost certainly killed in the line of duty.

key: ..Par voie de conséquence, moi et les collègues, on aimerait bien l'aide de la garde royale."
en: ... Consequently, my colleagues and I would greatly appreciate the assistance of the royal guard."

key: Une bien grande salle pour une bien grande peinture.
en: A great big room for a great big painting.

key: Le sceau du roi est reconnaissable au centre, mais pour le reste...
en: The seal of the King is recognizable at the centre, as for the rest...

key: Un tas de caisses et de vieilles lettres, rien de particulier.
en: A pile of old letters, nothing special.

key: Une des lettres porte le sceau du roi ! Elle est abîmée mais je peux tout de même la lire.
en: One of the letters bears the seal of the King! It's damaged but I can still read it.

key: "Le Géant ne fait désormais plus partie ... garde rapprochée.
en: "The Giant is not a member... guard anymore.

key: Transportez son corps dans la pris...
en: Take his body to the pris...

key: ...lance dans son corps devrait suffir, mais veillez également à ... qu'il ne se réveille jamais."
en: ... spear in his body should be enough, but make sure... he never wakes up."

key: Hum... Apparement, il s'est quand même reveillé.
en: Hmm... Apparently, he woke up anyway.

key: Étonnant, ce gros bout de métal dans cette réserve.
en: Funny, this big chunk of metal in this storeroom.

key: La stèle s'est décrochée du plafond et...
en: The tombstone dropped from the ceiling and...

key: Le pauvre n'aura pas échappé à son destin. Son antre est devenu son tombeau.
en: The poor guy could not escape fate. His lair became his tomb.

key: Hum, je comprends mieux pourquoi il voulait récupérer sa rune.
en: Hmm, I understand now why he wanted his rune back.

key: Cette pièce semble avoir été rajoutée après la construction du château.
en: This room seems to have been added after the construction of the castle.

key: J'ai déjà croisé ce genre d'étagères dans le chatêau du roi.
en: I've seen this type of shelves before, in the King's castle.

key: On dirait bien que j'ai passé un sale quart d'heure là-dessus.
en: Looks like I had a bad time with it.

key: Cet énorme squelette ne me dit rien qui vaille.
en: This huge skeleton doesn't bode well.

key: Je me demande bien qui l'a tué.
en: I really wonder who killed him.

key: Il a l'air beaucoup plus mort que moi.
en: He looks way more dead than me.
Yeah, he's not gonna move anytime soon.

key: C'est vraiment la taille de ses griffes qu'on voit sur le mur, là ?
en: Does he really have claws this size?

key: Le monstre qui a enfoncé la porte a fini sa course dans ce trou à lave.
en: He's gone INTO the lava? Guess he didn't want to come back after all...

key: Pas sûr d'avoir envie de le suivre.
en: I'm definitely not going in after him!

key: On dirait que cette créature a oublié quelque chose...
en: I think he might have forgotten something...

key: Répond aux demandes les plus inhabituelles depuis plus de 15 ans, et 8 mises à jour.
en: Responding to the most eccentric of demands for over 15 years and at least eight updates now.

key: Ces symboles vaguement religieux semblent évoquer une sainte figure maternelle...
en: Vaguely religious, these symbols seem to evoke a holy maternal figure...

key: ... Et une étrange exhortation a consommer du vin.
en: ...and a strange exhortation to consume wine?

key: "Apparement, voir nos morts se relever ne suffisaient pas..."
en: "Apparently seeing the dead rise wasn't enough..."
"Today it's the plants that are up and about raising hell."

key: "Le nouveau meilleur ami du Roi nous a ordonné de capturer un spécimène... vivant"
en: "The King's new best friend has ordered one of them captured... Alive..."

key: Comment ce squelette a-t-il pu rentrer dans la bouteille ?
en: How did they get the skeleton in the bottle?

key: "Seul face à la nature" et d'autre traités de botanique sont étendus sur le sol.
en: "Man vs Wild" and other botanical treatises are spread out on the ground.

key: Je me demande ce qu'il y a dans la fiole.
en: I wonder what's in this flask...

key: "Des infectés semblent piégés dans le tronc..."
en: It seems like these infected ones were trapped in the trunk...

key: "C’est à se demander qui est est vraiment le malade ici."
en: Makes you wonder who was the sick one in this story...

key: “Le crâne d’un corbeau géant mélangé à différentes sortes de tripes, d’organes et de racines locales…"
en: The skull of a giant crow mixed in with various bits of mushed and mashed organs, entrails and local roots...

key: "… Le tout relié à l’écorce d’un chêne carmin”
en: ...connected to the bark of an old red giant tree.
The perfect evil wizard starter kit...

key: "ATTENTION : NE PAS UTILISER POUR ARROSER LES PLANTES ! !"
Bois verni ... coussins recouverts de satin ...
Une tripotée de romans aux couvertures de cuir ...
en: A bunch of leather bound books...

key: Je me demande quel noble avait son jardin personnel ici.
en: I wonder which noble had their personal garden here.

key: Des gants, une fourche ... un courtisan s'essayait au jardinage ?
en: Gloves, a pitchfork... Maybe a courtier tried their hand at gardening?

key: Non, aucun d'entre eux n'aurait accepté de s'asseoir sur un divan aussi rustique.
en: No, you wouldn’t find one that would sit on such a shabby piece of furniture.

key: Il semblerait que le jardinier avait ses entrées au palais, lui aussi.
en: It seems the gardener had his entrances into the palace too.

key: C'est un tableau d'affichage, une note y est attachée.
en: A bulletin board, a note is tacked to it.

key: "N’oubliez pas de nettoyer régulièrement le cellier : la viande ne devrait pas rester plus de 3 ou 4 jours, après ça commence à sentir."
en: "Do not forget to clean the cellar on a regular basis: the meat will not last more than 3 or 4 days, after that it begins to emit a foul odor."

key: Il semblerait que l'un d'entre eux ait réussi à s'échapper...
en: It seems one of them made it out...

key: Le pauvre bougre n'est pas allé bien loin.
en: The poor guy didn't get far.

key: On dit que ce qui ne te tue pas te rend plus fort...
en: They say what doesn't kill you makes you stronger...

key: Si qui que ce soit est devenu plus fort grâce à ça, il doit être MONSTRUEUX !
en: If anybody's been living off that, they must be MONSTROUS!

key: Rien que l’odeur est déjà létale...
en: Just the smell is already lethal...

key: Je suis sûr d'avoir déjà vu ça quelque part...
en: I'm pretty sure I've seen this somewhere before...

key: Quelle est cette étrange créature accrochée à son visage ?
en: What is this strange creature stuck to his face?

key: Il frémit encore, comme s'il était à moitié vivant...
en: He still spasms a bit, as if he was half alive...

key: Trop traîner ici risquerait d'avoir des conséquences inattendues !
en: Staying too long could have unforeseen consequences!

key: Someone tried to drink directly from the barrel ?
en: Someone tried to drink directly from the barrel?

key: Old habits are hard to lose.
"One of the engineers was so happy with his new prototype that he went straight to the barrel dispenser to test it...''
en: "One of the engineers was so happy with his new prototype that he went straight to the barrel dispenser to test it...''

key: ''This level of stupidity would have got him fired if he didn't die in the process.''
en: ''This level of stupidity would have got him fired if he didn't die in the process.''

key: "By the King's command, you are to burn the Arboretum down until nothing is left but cinders.
en: "By the King's command, you are to burn the Arboretum down until nothing is left but cinders.

key: And ignore the gardener's protestations... he has no protection from the Castle anymore. "
en: And ignore the gardener's protestations... he is no longer under the Crown's protection."

key: "I'm alive again... but I can feel the madness lurking in the shadows. And I don't think that these medicinal plants will help me for long..."
en: "I'm alive again... but I can feel the madness lurking in the shadows. And I don't think these medicinal plants will help me for long..."

key: Yet another order to burn down the plants...
en: Yet another order to burn down the Arboretum...

key: "Writing help me keep what's left of my sanity. The Swamp people were stunningly friendly... Apparently, their Mother love flowers?
en: "Writing helps me keep what's left of my sanity. The swamp people were stunningly friendly... Apparently, their Mother loves flowers?"

key: The Priest helped me with a concotion done with the local herbs. Not sure if it's working, but I can definitely feel a new sort of pain in my stomach..."
en: Their Priest helped me with a concoction brewed from local herbs. Not sure if it's working, but I can definitely feel a new sort of pain in my stomach"

key: "I was hoping her people could help me, but they don't recognise me anymore.
en: "I was hoping her people could help me, but they don't recognise me anymore."

key: The apostate's hideout ain't far, but I don't know what kind of welcome they reserve to stranger in need of help these days."
en: "The Apostates' hideout isn't far, but I don't know what kind of welcome they reserve for strangers in need of help these days."

key: "Apostates didn't end up better than the rest of us.
en: "The Apostates didn't fare any better than the rest of us."

key: Moments of consciouscness are becoming rarer and shorter... I won't make it to the lighthouse.
en: "Moments of consciousness are becoming rarer and shorter... I won't make it to the Lighthouse."
"Maybe I'll find a decent place to rest down there"

key: "They didn't lie when they said the Queen's Temples were full of treasures waiting to be taken..."
en: "They didn't lie when they said the Queen's temples were full of treasures waiting to be taken..."

key: "Thought they could have mentioned their wardens"
en: "Though they could have mentioned the wardens"

key: "The Apostates fleed when they saw us approched... The King is right, they must behind that sickness!
en: "The Apostates fled when they saw us approach... The King is right, they must be behind that sickness!"

key: I'm staying here with a few of my men while the others are going back to the Castle, with all the apostate's scrolls and books we could gather."
en: "I'm staying here with a few of my men while the others are going back to the Castle, with all the Apostates' scrolls and books that we could gather."

key: Maybe the Alchemist can find a remedy in there?
en: "Maybe the Alchemist can find a remedy in there?"

key: "Apostates' researches on death and cellular decay were far more advanced that what I've seen elsewhere....
en: "The Apostates' research on death and cellular decay were far more advanced than what I've seen elsewhere....

key: They seem to endure better than the rest of the island.
en: They seem to endure better than the rest of the island.

key: We shared knowledge, and they handed me some precious samples. There may be another way to endure the Malaise..."
en: We shared knowledge, and they handed me some precious samples. There may be another way to endure the Malaise..."

key: Wooden boats. They wanted to flee.
en: Wooden boats. They wanted to flee.
"The King came to my quarters to personally remove the portrait of the Giant and I together. I understand his frustration, but my men were rattled..."
"The Hand is above the King's suspicion, which is more than I can say for the Giant... Though I secretly hope he's ok, we've not seen him in a while now."
"There's a strange taste to the food since the old cook was offed. The Hand doesn't seem to mind though, so I just hold my nose and dream of custard."

"The King is convinced of the existence of a plot against his life. While such a plot may have cause to exist, I've seen no evidence of it. Worse, the food hasn't been up to standard since he had the cook executed..."

key: There's a small bug in this jar.
en: There's a small bug in this jar.

key: Something feels off... as if the bug was a potent weapon of sorts...
en: Something feels off... as if the bug was a potent weapon of sorts...

key: Hmm... people fled this room hastily, judging from the mess they left behind.
en: Hmm... People fled this room hastily, judging by the mess they left behind.

key: I hate those guys! And it seems someone really did too...
en: I hate those guys! And it seems someone else really did too...

key: I hope I'll never meet them!
en: I hope I never meet them!

key: Whoever did that mess wasn't too fond of the experiments done here.
en: Whoever made that mess wasn't too fond of the experiments being done here.
I feel like sitting on it would be a great relief.
So menacing! Should I really search it?
Oh, it's not like it's cursed or anything.
Look at these strange little men holding it!
Some of these skulls look so badass!
I feel uneasy when I'm next to this... monolith.
I hope that they'll make statues of me someday!

key: Poor guy: lost his job, died, became home to a small parasite...
en: Poor guy: lost his job, died, became home to a small parasite...

key: It goes from various lighthouse-related tasks each day to a succession of weeks filled with the word "Nothing".
en: It goes from various lighthouse-related tasks each day to a succession of weeks filled with the word "Nothing".

key: Looks like Michel's life was really boring in the end.
en: Looks like Michel's life was really boring in the end.

key: "It's been a week now that the Lighthouse has been extinguished. We, the guardians of the tower have been required to move to the village. All that because someone saw a weird scallop on the beach.... Let me tell you, I've been a keeper for my whole life, it's not a scallop that can frighten me."
en: "It's been a week now that the Lighthouse has been extinguished. We, the guardians of the tower have been required to move to the village. All that because someone saw a weird scallop on the beach.... Let me tell you, I've been a keeper for my whole life, it's not a scallop that can frighten me."

key: These eggs have definitely not been laid by a chicken.
en: These eggs have definitely not been laid by a chicken.

key: They seem to be trembling from time to time.
en: They seem to be trembling from time to time.

key: That trident must have belonged to someone important
en: That trident must have belonged to someone important.
These people died of waiting for too long... It must have been such a drag!
A security notice for the Bank's staff.
"Don't put food close to the merchants' bags, they seem to have been compromised.". What does a bag eat, though?
A treatise on the Philosopher's Stone. Only the last page remains.
"... That's how you can find the mythical Philosopher's Stone. What a journey!"
An economy textbook. It seems to be the only book in the room to have ever been opened.
What's with that invisible hand? What do ghosts have to do with economy?!
An old, dusty tome. It looks like it hasn't been used since its addition to the archives.
Its title is partially unreadable. Only "The Cap..." and a photo of one of those small green people with an impressive beard can be identified.
Someone violently tore the merchants' bags open with a large variety of weapons. They must really hate containers.
These bags have been pierced in multiple places. They seem to be empty.
A deep voice comes out of this strange contraption: "Wrong number...".
A massive wood desk. It probably belongs to someone important.
An old journal is opened on a page titled "Zero//NULL".
Blah blah blah amnesia, blah blah secret program, time-controlling drugs... when does it get interesting?!
...Wait, what?! I want to control time too!
A really comfortable looking armchair. It makes you want to kick back, relax and confide to whoever's around... if you have anything to recount, that is...
A sober and elegant low table.
There's a note covered in words: "KILL KILL KILL KILL KILL KILL".
Not too diversified, but it gives you something to think about! I'm convinced!

Its eye slowly pulses. It looks like a discharged weapon. 
Fortunately, this big dude is out of commission!
A strange stone arch. I feel like... it's talking to me?
Hum, nice sword. Why leave it there inside this ugly monster? That's the best way to have it stolen from you.
Oh! A sword on the ground! I spotted it first!
Woooooow! What is that enormous pile of corpses?!
It's as if someone tried to make a ball of it.
I wouldn't be too fond of fighting such a horror... moreover, I suck at aerial combat.
Hey ... it looks like it's still breathing!
I'd better not stay here for too long.
There is a large floating polyhedron in the middle of the room and nothing else.
Nothing. I don't even feel much more saved than before.
Such a beautiful shield! I shall try it on a skeleton!
The beautiful white cat that was carrying the key to his owner's prison.
He's so cuuuuuuuuute!.. And vicious... a proud member of his species.
This carriage seems to have swerved right into the Castle's front gate. Its driver must have been distracted by a VERY big insect.
A shelf filled with the full arsenal of the perfect vampire hunter.
Leather armor, garlic bulbs, whip... even hair lotion, "for flyaway hair".
The statue of a hooded young woman.
Just like the shelf nearby, it looks really ancient.
A little plaque on the base reads "Sypha Belnades".
She looks like a witch, but one of the good ones.
A gory display: frightening skull, maimed corpse, reversed cross, purple flames,...
They've got it all. These guys are pros. Respect.
A mask with a comically long beak. Someone doesn't want to get too close to other people, I see.
"Death is a blessing. Glory to its priests."
Hmm, that's not really a positive motto...
Then, am I a saint to them? Considering how often I die...
Some poor fellows begging the sinister masked figure.
Are they praying for his blessing... or for their lives to be spared?
This little guy seems to be the assistant of the towering figure next to him.
I'm sure he just wants to help and is really likeable.
An impressive board covered in papers, raging inscriptions and red yarn to link everything.
A few sentences are readable among all that mess.
"...and that's why I remain convinced that the Malaise doesn't exist. All the people on the island are simply pretending because they were paid for it!"
"Who would believe that they really are undeads? Not me, that's for sure! However, did you know that our beloved Queen is in fact a serpent? No? Not surprising!"
A rope acts as a link between this musty bed and the cluster of bells hanging above it.
It looks like a makeshit alarm system... or a good way to never fall asleep.
